InfraBot: ALERT: 2024-06-12T14:11:02Z analytics-service returned 500 for 54 requests in last 5m. https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/9802 :rotating_light:
Aisha (support): Heads-up — multiple customers reporting console graphs failing to load (tiles spin indefinitely). Seeing analytics-api 500s/timeouts in network tab. Repro steps below.
Aisha (support): Repro steps:
1) Console -> Dashboards -> open 'Usage by Region'
2) Select 30d time range -> Apply
3) Tile spins, network shows 500 from analytics API and chart renders empty
Aisha (support): Example curl we captured from support machine:
```
curl -X POST "https://analytics.redwood.internal/v1/query" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" \
  -H "x-request-id: rq-20240612-7f3a" \
  -d '{"query":"SELECT sum(tokens) FROM events WHERE org_id=\"acme\" AND ts >= now() - interval 30 day"}'
# Response: 500 Internal Server Error
# body: {"error":"internal error","code":500}
```
Tom (eng-analytics): Can you paste the x-request-id / trace id from the browser devtools for one failing tile? Also which customers affected?
Aisha (support): x-request-id: rq-20240612-7f3a, trace-id: trace-0a3f. Affected accounts: acme, bluefin, test-org-3. I attached screenshots to INC-2345.
Jules (eng-infra): I see a deploy to analytics-service around 14:09 UTC from deploy-bot. Could be related. Which query-id did the analytics service log show?
Aisha (support): logs showed query_id=qry-8f6b, request_id=rq-20240612-7f3a (pasted above).
Luis (sre): Looking at analytics-service logs (excerpt):
```
2024-06-12T14:10:45Z [ERROR] query_executor.go:210 query_id=qry-8f6b request_id=rq-20240612-7f3a msg="timeout acquiring clickhouse connection after 30s"
2024-06-12T14:10:45Z [WARN] pool.go:87 active=120 max=120 waiting=6
```
Luis (sre): Pool appears saturated, clients queued and then timed out -> 500s. This matches failing tiles which make larger range queries.
Tom (eng-analytics): That matches a regression we introduced in the new planner that increases concurrent CH sessions for long-range aggregations. Short-term mitigation: reduce max concurrent queries or enable short-circuit cache for dashboard tiles. I can patch a limiter.
Jules (eng-infra): I'm going to roll back the analytics v2 canary to v2.2 for the canary pool now. Pushing rollback at 14:22 UTC. Monitoring dashboards.
Aisha (support): Created INC-2345, notified impacted customers and prioritized. Will post updates here. :eyes:
InfraBot: Deploy action: rollback analytics-service canary -> v2.2 initiated at 2024-06-12T14:23:18Z
InfraBot: Deploy action: rollback analytics-service canary -> v2.2 completed at 2024-06-12T14:26:12Z
Aisha (support): Confirmed with ACME test account — tiles are loading again, charts rendering for the 30d range. Marking recovery in the incident. :white_check_mark:
Luis (sre): I'll open a follow-up ticket to add a connection-pool-saturation alert, increase CH pool metrics retention, and add a circuit-breaker to return cached tile data instead of hard 500s.
Tom (eng-analytics): I'll prepare a PR to throttle long-range queries and add query cost estimation before executing. We'll also add a canary pre-check for pool utilization.
Jules (eng-infra): Leaving the rollback in place until we validate 2h of healthy metrics, then plan a controlled re-deploy with the limiter.
Aisha (support): Thanks all — closing the support escalation for now, will update INC-2345 once we have the postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
